verdict.rationale: ByteAsk's docs describe an agent that reads the whole codebase, edits files, compiles, runs tests, and presents a diff before committing changes — the core plain-language-to-multi-file-code-change workflow — corroborated by the product's own llms.txt describing it as 'an AI coding agent for C and C++' that edits the repository and drives the real toolchain. Missing for 10: explicit examples/case studies of multi-file feature/bug implementations, and independent (non-vendor) hands-on validation of correctness across files.
